name: SBI-trained EfficientNet-B0 (local, FFHQ self-blend)
source_url: local training: experiments/train_detector.py + experiments/sbi.py on FFHQ parquet (CC-BY-NC 4.0 for FFHQ-derived research use)
limitations: Checkpoint is not committed; reproduce with experiments/train_detector.py --sbi --augment-degradation --arch efficientnet_b0 (CPU ~10 min, 720-image set).
Measured in-domain (FFHQ-like faces): AUROC ~0.90 incl. jpeg75/50%-resize variants; AUROC 0.94, FPR 0.05, recall 0.70 on clean samples.

Measured cross-domain (old/damaged/low-quality portraits): AUROC ~0.72 with FPR ~0.67 at score 50 — sepia, scanned, or heavily compressed real faces can be flagged. Treat scores on such photos as unreliable.
crop_faces=true: face-free images are skipped (unavailable) rather than scored.
Detects self-blend-style manipulation artifacts; a real faceswap generator (FaceSwap/DeepFaceLab) may produce different artifacts — treat as a review signal.
A low score is not evidence of an authentic face; a high score is not proof of malicious manipulation.
notes: Model logits are (real=0, fake=1); score_index 1 with softmax yields the fake probability on a 0-100 scale.

Trained on 360 real FFHQ faces + 360 face-region self-blend manipulations with both-class JPEG/resize degradation augmentation (without it, recompression alone drove FPR to 1.0 — see FACESWAP_EVALUATION.md).
Same-distribution validation AUROC 0.93; the honest operating numbers are the eval-harness figures in the limitations above.
